name: Utsav Dhandhiya
title: AI Engineer
summary: AI Engineer with 3+ years in mission-critical industrial systems, building production-grade GenAI applications: stateful LangGraph agents, RAG pipelines on Pinecone, LLM observability with LangSmith, and an MCP server that cuts CV tailoring from ~45 minutes to under 2. AWS Certified AI Practitioner. Bringing reliability-engineering discipline from high-uptime power plants to LLM systems that are traceable, fault-tolerant, and built to ship.

bullets: Architected a production-ready, stateful LLM chatbot using LangChain and LangGraph with tool-augmented reasoning, enabling complex multi-step query resolution.
Engineered real-time token streaming and persistent session memory, delivering a seamless conversational experience across multi-session interactions.
Designed and deployed an end-to-end RAG pipeline with document ingestion, chunking, and semantic retrieval over Pinecone vector database, improving response accuracy on domain-specific queries.
Optimized prompt engineering strategies for OpenAI LLM APIs, reducing hallucination and improving contextual relevance across diverse user inputs.
Instrumented full LLM observability and trace-based debugging via LangSmith, enabling rapid iteration and production-grade reliability monitoring.

Oversaw reliability and performance of 9 large-scale power generation units (5×660 MW, 4×330 MW) in a high-uptime, mission-critical industrial environment - building strong systems-engineering and fault-diagnosis discipline.

Engineered and optimized control logic across Distributed Control Systems (DCS) platforms including Invensys Foxboro and GE OC4000, demonstrating deep understanding of complex, stateful system architectures.
Applied structured analytical methodologies to diagnose system inefficiencies and drive operational improvements - directly transferable to debugging and optimizing AI/ML pipelines.

projects.name: YouTube Chat Assistant
bullets: Architected an end-to-end conversational RAG pipeline that ingests any YouTube video via URL - automating transcript extraction, text chunking, embedding, and semantic indexing into Pinecone vector database.
Designed a stateful multi-turn agent workflow using LangGraph, enabling context-aware follow-up queries with persistent session memory across the full conversation.
Integrated an LLM deployed on Azure AI Foundry, handling semantic retrieval and answer synthesis over video-specific knowledge - keeping responses grounded and hallucination-resistant.
Instrumented end-to-end LLM observability and trace monitoring via LangSmith, enabling pipeline debugging and performance tracking at each reasoning step.

projects.name: CV-Tailor (MCP Server)
bullets: Built a Python MCP server that turns an existing CV and a job description into a tailored .docx CV, reducing tailoring time from ~45 min to under 2 min with near-complete JD keyword coverage across 5 test runs.
Designed the pipeline (PDF/DOCX extraction, LLM structuring, JD matching, rendering) with anti-hallucination guardrails that preserve exact metrics and never fabricate details.
